title: Accelerated Quickstarts: experiments cadence, OKR mapping, and funnel metrics
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Run a 6-week initiative to accelerate developer activation via redesigned quickstarts, cohort experiments, and an OKR-aligned measurement cadence. This ticket coordinates PM/Design/Eng work to (1) run three parallel quickstart experiments targeting Node/React/Python SDK users, (2) instrument funnel metrics and signal contracts for quality regressions, and (3) map the results to Q1 DevX OKRs so decisions on scaling templates and creating onboarding budgets can be made.
objectives: Reduce median time-to-first-successful-API-call (TTFASC) from 18m -> 6m for new signups
Increase 7-day cohort retention of quickstart users by 12%
Create a repeatable experiment cadence and signal contract for quickstart regressions
Produce a go/no-go recommendation for templated quickstart rollout by end of cycle
success_metrics: Median TTFASC <= 6 minutes for 90% of test cohort
7-day retention lift >= 12% vs control (stat sig p<0.05)
Template adoption rate >= 35% in experiment cohorts
Fewer than 1 critical bug per cohort during experiment window
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation: funnel events shipped to analytics (signup -> sample repo clone -> run local quickstart -> first API call)
Experiment infra: feature flags and cohort routing in place and validated
Three quickstart variants built (Node, React, Python) with sample app, README, and smoke tests
Signal contract doc published describing evaluation set and alert thresholds
A/B analysis notebook and executive one-pager with recommendation completed
updates: 2025-01-20: Kickoff completed. Agreed on cohorts (randomized, stratified by org size). Action: Eng to prototype lightweight feature flag routing (ENG-62301).
2025-01-28: Design reviewed quickstart flows; tightened copy to surface billing/cost estimates earlier — reducing surprise friction. Design asked to prioritize 'first-call snippet' in top of README.

2025-02-03: Engineering spike finished — continuous integration for quickstart templates added (CI pipeline PR: github.com/redwood-inference/qs-templates/pull/79). Smoke tests run on linux/mac. Initial latency of templates during local start measured (~45s cold start).

2025-02-10: Analytics instrumentation merged (analytics PR: github.com/redwood-inference/devx-analytics/pull/214). Funnel events validated in staging; data schema added to signal contract doc (docs.google.com/document/d/1aA-qsig).

2025-02-16: First 2-week experiment cohort (n=480) launched for Node quickstart. Early telemetry: 25% hit first-call within 5 minutes; baseline was 9%. Recording live dashboard at /dashboards/devx/quickstarts-experiments.
2025-02-20: Observability - added lightweight regression monitors: daily drop >15% in first-call rate triggers triage runbook. Alert thresholds documented in console-2025.03 runbook.
2025-02-22: Midpoint checkpoint with stakeholders. Decision to pause React variant until smoke test coverage reaches 90% due to flaky CI. Planning a hotfix sprint for flaky tests next cycle.
risks: Instrumentation lag — events may arrive with delay causing noisy early analysis
Template maintenance cost if we expand to >6 SDKs without automation
False positives from flaky CI may block rollout decisions
Customer privacy: ensure sample data does not contain PII in analytics pipeline
next_steps: Address flaky tests: Eng to triage flaky test root causes (owner: Priya Shah, ENG-62455)
Complete React quickstart rebuild with stricter smoke tests by 2025-02-28
Run power analysis to confirm cohort sizes for statistical significance (owner: Data Science)
Prepare executive one-pager and OKR mapping deck for 2025-03-05 review
notes: Trade-offs discussed: deep-first UX improvements (optimize for fastest path) vs. maintaining parity across SDKs. Team agreed to prioritize fastest-path for initial experiments and platform the broader parity work in a follow-up.
Approval: Finance has provisionally approved a small onboarding budget for paid ads driving test cohorts (email thread linked in drive doc).
Follow-up ticket recommended to capture templated quickstart governance (ownership, review cadence, localization plan).
